newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn mostly up, wheat flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn mostly up, wheat flat.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB corn and soybean basis values were mostly higher Thursday in very quiet dealings, export sources said.
News that India has plans to import up to two million tonnes of wheat during April through March captured the attention of most exporters, but none of the business is expected to go to the U.S.
Exporters said that India has already begun purchasing the wheat, and most of it is expected to come from Australia.
Soybean values were boosted by talk that China purchased both U.S. soybeans and soymeal.
However, traders could offer no confirmation of the deal.
